LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Musical Instruments. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Musical Instruments
2. Practise Musical Instruments at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Musical Instruments

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Musical Instruments
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Musical Instruments. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Musical Instruments at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Musical Instruments at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Musical Instruments
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Musical Instruments. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Musical Instruments using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Musical Instruments in the examples.
2. Explain Musical Instruments to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Musical Instruments.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Musical Instruments using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Musical Instruments important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners listen to sounds of different dancing? to accompany singing and 2. Which instruments percussion instruments and name them. dancing to enhance are played by communication,
2. Collecting used materials and objects from the community for use in improvising percussion instruments (recycling programs)
3. Visiting older citizens to learn how to improvise and play different percussion instruments Suggested Resources

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Musical Instruments
2. Practise Musical Instruments at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Musical Instruments
